$comment: R-003 signalling ground truth. Public facts only; undocumented technical parameters stay design_model/unknown.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Fixed zones with one-train occupancy are a source-backed baseline; exact block boundaries are design_model until sourced.
facts.limitations: No public package-A block plan or lengths were found.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Track circuits may be represented as the source-backed mechanism forming legacy fixed zones.
facts.limitations: Circuit boundaries, electrical parameters and failure logic are not public.

facts.simulation_abstraction: A train-protection abstraction may automatically slow/intervene when the protected separation is not respected.
facts.limitations: Do not assign real KCV/ATP curves, thresholds or reaction times without a source.

facts.simulation_abstraction: ATS is a distinct supervision/dispatch layer and must not bypass train protection.
facts.limitations: No public dispatch algorithm or real decision thresholds.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Future CBTC may use a vendor-neutral dynamic/variable separation abstraction instead of the legacy fixed-zone occupancy model.
facts.limitations: Do not infer the real positioning accuracy, radio layer, moving-authority algorithm or safety buffer.

facts.simulation_abstraction: The historical scenario on 2026-08-31 remains classic_2026; CBTC is limited to explicit test/future modes.
facts.limitations: STIB states commissioning follows completion of installation and tests across all of lines 1 and 5.

facts.simulation_abstraction: May exist as an explicitly labelled test scenario, never as network-wide historical service.
facts.limitations: Do not infer continuous operational CBTC passenger service from test closures.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Test scenarios may distinguish static validation from dynamic train-running tests and may label Beekkant/common-trunk validation as historical test activity.
facts.limitations: The source does not publish test scripts, acceptance thresholds, protocol traces or safety parameters.
A plan is not proof of commissioning.
A plan is not proof of commissioning.

facts.simulation_abstraction: KCV remains a source-backed interface/function on lines 2/6; protocol internals remain outside the simulator.
facts.limitations: No telegram format, frequency, locator geometry or safety curve is public in the checked sources.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Future mode can preserve KCV-facing functions and add a vendor-neutral positioning abstraction.
Expose only these source-backed functional interfaces; do not emulate a real protocol.
facts.limitations: Functions are public; implementation and safety logic are not.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Vendor remains provenance metadata; runtime interfaces stay vendor-neutral.
facts.limitations: Vendor identity does not license reuse of proprietary implementation details.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Documents programme scope only; it does not change the historical 2026 operating mode.
facts.limitations: Contract scope and product capability are not proof of UTO operation in 2026.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Allows later domain interfaces between signalling supervision and passenger-information events without asserting protocol details.
facts.limitations: No message schemas or interfaces were published in the checked source.

facts.simulation_abstraction: UTO must remain a future gated scenario and cannot be inferred from CBTC equipment alone.
facts.limitations: No station-by-station implementation state is inferred here.

facts.simulation_abstraction: Use only as a programme-level cross-check after timetable/physics modelling.
facts.limitations: Not a guaranteed timetable headway and not a safety margin.

unknown_parameters: complete signal aspect tables and placement
CBTC/KCV radio or telegram formats, frequencies and network topology
exact balise/localiser parameters and positioning algorithm
